en.headline: Former hospital doctor given community service for misappropriating drugs
en.dek: Lee Chi-leung, a former associate consultant at Queen Elizabeth Hospital, was sentenced to 160 hours of community service and ordered to pay HK$20,000 after being found guilty of misconduct in public office.
body: A former ear, nose and throat specialist at Queen Elizabeth Hospital was sentenced on Thursday to 160 hours of community service and ordered to pay HK$20,000 in compensation to the Hospital Authority for misconduct in public office.

District Court Judge Josiah Lam Wai-kuen found that Lee Chi-leung, 51, had between March 2015 and September 2020 dishonestly obtained more than 1,000 bottles of cough syrup and over 400 tablets of ADHD medication by making fake appointments under the names of family members and domestic helpers, and by prescribing excess amounts to patients and reclaiming the surplus for his own use. The Independent Commission Against Corruption investigated the case.

The judge noted that Lee had resigned, was remorseful and had previously been held in high regard by colleagues and patients. Lee is expected to face a separate disciplinary hearing before the Medical Council.

zh.headline: 前伊院醫生公職人員行為失當 判160小時社會服務令
zh.dek: 前伊利沙伯醫院副顧問醫生李志良因公職人員行為失當，被判160小時社會服務令及向醫管局賠償2萬元，涉及以虛假預約及過量處方方式取得咳藥水及治療專注力不足藥物。
body: 一名前伊利沙伯醫院耳鼻喉科副顧問醫生星期四被判160小時社會服務令，並須向醫院管理局賠償2萬元，罪名是公職人員行為失當。
區域法院法官林偉權裁定，51歲李志良於2015年3月至2020年9月期間，以家人及外傭名義預約虛假診症、處方過量咳藥水予兩名病人後取回剩餘，以及以其他方式不正當地取得超過1,000支咳藥水及400多粒治療專注力不足及過度活躍症藥物供私人使用。案件由廉政公署調查。
法官指被告已辭職、表現悔意，過往獲同事及病人評價甚高。李志良預計稍後須面對醫務委員會紀律研訊。
